item.title: Batavia Rotary partners with restaurants in composting initiative to reduce landfill waste
item.description: Press ReleaseThe Rotary Club of Batavia has launched a food scrap composting initiative designed to reduce landfill waste and promote environmental sustainability across the region.The program partners with local restaurants to divert food waste to EcoVerde Organics, an industrial composting facility in Akron, New York.
